attempts.text: MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' RETURN type(r) t, count(*) c ORDER BY c DESC
MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' RETURN type(r) AS t, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE EXISTS{(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}) AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p)) RETURN length(p) AS l, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WITH p, [n IN nodes(p) | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) | x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) AND size(reduce(s=[],n IN nodes(p)| CASE WHEN n IN s THEN s ELSE s+n END))=size(nodes(p)) RETURN length(p) AS l, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]-(b:Issue) WITH p, [n IN nodes(p) | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) | x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) AND size(reduce(s=[],n IN nodes(p)| CASE WHEN n IN s THEN s ELSE s+n END))=size(nodes(p)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.issueKey] AS path, asg AS people, [n IN nodes(p) | head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x) | x.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN relationships(p) | r.linkId] AS links

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WITH p, [n IN nodes(p) | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) | x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) AND size(reduce(s=[],n IN nodes(p)| CASE WHEN n IN s THEN s ELSE s+n END))=size(nodes(p)) RETURN [r IN relationships(p) | r.linkId] AS path, [r IN relationships(p) | [startNode(r).issueKey, endNode(r).issueKey]] AS issues, [i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) | [asg[i],asg[i+1]]] AS people, [r IN relationships(p) | [head([(startNode(r))-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x) | x.projectKey]), head([(endNode(r))-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x) | x.projectKey])]] AS projects
